import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
r,g,b=im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
# yellow mask: high r, high g, low b
yellow=(r>140)&(g>110)&(b<90)&(r-b>70)
print(\"yellow px:\", yellow.sum())
ys,xs=np.where(yellow)
if len(xs): print(\"yellow bbox x\",xs.min(),xs.max(),\"y\",ys.min(),ys.max())
# gray mask
gray=(np.abs(r.astype(int)-g)<12)&(np.abs(g.astype(int)-b)<12)
ys2,xs2=np.where(gray)
print(\"gray bbox x\",xs2.min(),xs2.max(),\"y\",ys2.min(),ys2.max())
# brown/wood: r>g>b
wood=(r>60)&(r<150)&(g>35)&(g<105)&(b<70)&(r>g)&(g>b)
ys3,xs3=np.where(wood)
print(\"wood bbox x\",xs3.min(),xs3.max(),\"y\",ys3.min(),ys3.max())
# print as coarse ascii map 64x36
H,W=144,256
small=np.zeros((36,64),dtype=int)
for yy in range(36):
    for xx in range(64):
        block=im[yy*4:(yy+1)*4,xx*4:(xx+1)*4]
        mr,mg,mb=block.reshape(-1,3).mean(0)
        if mr>140 and mg>110 and mb<90 and mr-mb>70: ch='Y'
        elif abs(mr-mg)<14 and abs(mg-mb)<14 and mr>60: ch='#' if mr>120 else '+'
        elif mr>mg>mb and mr<160: ch='w'
        elif mr<40 and mg<40: ch='.'
        else: ch='?'
        small[yy,xx]=ord(ch)
for row in small:
    print(''.join(map(chr,row)))
EOF"
